clips.label: Low
clips.prompt: A single spherical orange pebbled rubber training ball with black basketball-style curved channels rests near the right edge of a raised concrete loading dock. A brief horizontal force pushes the ball off the dock. It falls and can bounce on the visible lower concrete ground. The ball stays round with its surface pattern visible throughout, and the camera remains fixed.
